proposal: Most of AI 2 is not one big mistake but the same five small things written over and over: a progress bar (four copies in ai2.css, one more in v3), a boxless text button, a link row with a status edge, a small rounded chip, and a status dot. Build each once in framework.css (the bar can start from ext/AITask/ai.css:469, which already exists), then delete the copies; that is roughly 300 lines out of AI 2 alone. Next, swap the hand-written layouts for words that already exist: .wall for the V3 card grid, .grid.auto for v3's two-column demo and v2's panel row, .masonry for the overview's columns, .card for v2's panels, .pad for the empty state, and .flex/.flex-1 for the overview columns and the talk form. Nine lines of group-what/line CSS are provably unused and can go at once. What stays is the genuinely page-specific part: the rail | card | sub-card | chat grid, the Live card's 2/3/4-column container grid, and the phone one-screen-at-a-time rules. Finally, add two general things the owner already wants: a container-unit --pad token (ai2.css:985 is the prototype) and a page word for 'this page is an app, hide the title and zero the gutter', which v2, v3 and AI 2 all write by hand.
risk: medium — the bar, row and chip components touch four sheets and must be built and proven once before any copy is deleted; the DUPLICATE/DELETE swaps are low risk.
